policy: Review lockfile-backed preinstall, install, and postinstall consumer hooks by exact package path, version, integrity, platform posture, and allowed installed hook names. Treat package-author publishing metadata as separate context.

packages.dependencyRole: Optional Darwin file-watching dependency carried by development tooling; it is intentionally absent from Windows and Linux installs.
packages.rationale: The lockfile declares a consumer install script and pins the registry tarball. Platform and optional constraints prevent execution on unsupported hosts; any path, version, integrity, or hook-name drift requires review.

packages.dependencyRole: Optional Darwin file-watching dependency nested under Playwright browser tooling; it is intentionally absent from Windows and Linux installs.
packages.rationale: The nested lock entry is optional and Darwin-only even though npm does not mark it dev-only. The exact registry tarball and allowed install hook are pinned for drift detection.

packages.dependencyRole: Optional native image-processing runtime used through Next.js image optimization.
packages.rationale: Next.js installs Sharp as an optional runtime dependency. Its install check selects an already pinned platform package or falls back to a native build; any identity or hook drift requires review.

packages.dependencyRole: Development-only native resolver reached through eslint-config-next and eslint-import-resolver-typescript.
packages.rationale: The postinstall hook validates the platform-specific native resolver binding used by the lint toolchain. Exact path, version, integrity, and hook name are pinned.
